about: A fast desktop app for looking at and exporting data from your databases.

prs.title: Database exports keep mixed-case table names
prs.broken: Exporting a Postgres database with mixed-case table names, the default for Prisma, stopped with an error and left a half-written file.
prs.changed: Names with capital letters are now quoted in the export, and each export uses the right SQL style for its database.
prs.matters: Exports from Prisma and similar projects finish and restore with the same table names.

prs.title: Dates export cleanly to CSV and Markdown
prs.broken: Exporting query results wrapped every date and time in extra quote marks, so a spreadsheet read them as text instead of dates.
prs.changed: I made the export write dates as plain date and time text, with no quotes added.
prs.matters: Exported tables open in a spreadsheet with dates it can sort and filter.

prs.title: MySQL exports keep backslashes in text
prs.broken: SQL exports for MySQL wrote backslashes in text as they were, which MySQL reads as escapes, so restored data changed or the import failed.
prs.changed: Backslashes are now escaped in exported strings.
prs.matters: Exported data restores exactly as it was.
